credits.title: Dear Ajayi
credits.overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

credits.title: The Other Side of the Bridge
credits.overview: A former teenage boxing champion returns to the ring to save his trainer’s gym, facing a rival from a different part of Lagos.

credits.title: A Night in 2005
credits.overview: What started out as a fun night at a prom after party in 2005, quickly turns into Ife’s worst nightmare. She carries a dark secret from that night into adulthood that continues to plague her everyday life.

credits.title: Gangs of Lagos
credits.overview: A group of friends who each have to navigate their own destiny, growing up on the bustling streets and neighborhood of Isale Eko, Lagos.

credits.title: Dwindle
credits.overview: Dwindle is a film based on the story of Sogo and Buta, two friends who hijack a car and venture into cabbing and how their lives take a drastic turn when their path runs into assassins who have just kidnapped the state governor.
